name: Karakusa Rei
source:
A staff at head quarter of Fill Flower, he is responsible for training new employees as well supervising operations. He previously also worked as manager at one of Fill Flower branch.
New staffs fears him and call him "devil instructor," but he is kind at heard and is loved by his juniors.
He was the employee tutor for [url=/c135202]Serina[/url] and [url=/c135205]Miku[/url]'s senpai during university days.
